messages.content: Use web search to find relevant datasets. Only include landing pages or DOIs. Do not invent links. Do not call time, date, timestamp, or clock tools.

Query: Can you find datasets about HISTORY in Germany, England, Sweden, and United States of America during the 1950s and 1960s and 1970s and 1980s and 1990s and 2000s?
Respond ONLY as JSON in this exact shape: {"items":[{"title":"...","url_or_doi":"...","justification":"..."}]}. Put any DOI, URL, landing page, or link in url_or_doi.

queries: historical statistics Germany 1950 2000 dataset destatis genesis
UK historical statistics datasets 1950 2000 ONS England
United States historical statistics 1950 2000 census IPUMS NHGIS
